title: yaks member keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/member adds to a component vocabulary. A component declaring `floor` asks that much of whoever writes it, whatever the app's access mode: the guard refuses a change that writes or removes the component for a principal who does not stand on the floor.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocabulary file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [memberKeywords]).

floor.description: The least a writer of this component holds. "person" is anyone signed in; "viewer", "editor" and "owner" are that level on the app, or more. Absent, the app's access mode decides alone.
